answer_1.quote: We adapt all tasks into generation forms with constructed generative formats to enable unified generative training.
answer_1.outputs: label word VERB(L) appended by the [eos] indicator or original answer A

answer_2.quote: We use micro-F1 score to evaluate all relation extraction tasks. Since causal NLI only has two labels(entailment and contradiction), we evaluate them by binary-F1 score. We denote both micro-F1 and binary-F1 as F1. We use F1score (F1), EM to measure QA task. F1 measures the correctness of uni-grams in generated sentence comparing those in ground truth sentences. EM score measures the exactly matches of uni-grams. Multiple choice tasks are measured by accuracy.
